t: Forge Steel 3-piece rasp set designed for shaping and smoothing wood. Features 3 durable 200mm tools, essential for various woodworking tasks, from initial material removal to fine finishing. Comprises flat, round, and half-round profiles, offering versatility for carpenters, joiners, and serious DIY enthusiasts working on timber and wood. Each rasp is double-sided for extended use, and the oil-coated carbon steel blades ensure lasting sharpness and corrosion resistance. Bi-material comfort-grip handles provide enhanced user control and reduce fatigue during prolonged shaping projects.
b: Contains Flat, Round & Half-Round Rasp Profiles
